book_cn: 上外版选择性必修第二册
unit_cn: Unit 2 Language and Mind 语言与思维
source: 上外版选择性必修二 Unit 2 词表(真词,跳过专有名词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、语言与思维/双语大脑/濒危语言主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.meaning_cn: 最精彩的部分;要点;强调
words.example_en: The highlight of the lecture was how language shapes the way we think.
words.example_cn: 讲座最精彩的部分是语言如何塑造我们的思维方式。

words.meaning_cn: 磁的;有磁性的;有吸引力的
words.example_en: Doctors used a magnetic scanner to study the bilingual brain.
words.example_cn: 医生用磁性扫描仪研究双语者的大脑。

words.example_en: Magnetic resonance imaging lets scientists watch the brain at work.
words.example_cn: 磁共振成像让科学家观察大脑工作的过程。

words.example_en: Brain imaging shows that learning a language changes its structure.
words.example_cn: 脑成像显示,学习语言会改变大脑的结构。

words.example_en: The students were given a brain scan before and after the course.
words.example_cn: 学生们在课程前后各做了一次脑部扫描。

words.example_en: Language learning is a promising way to keep the mind sharp.
words.example_cn: 学语言是保持头脑敏锐的一种有希望的方法。

words.example_en: Bilingual people often enjoy enhanced memory and attention.
words.example_cn: 双语者往往拥有更强的记忆力和注意力。

words.example_en: Learning a second language brings real cognitive benefits.
words.example_cn: 学习第二语言能带来实实在在的认知益处。

words.example_en: In some memory tests, bilingual children outperform their classmates.
words.example_cn: 在一些记忆测试中,双语儿童的表现胜过同学。

words.example_en: The study was published in a well-known science journal.
words.example_cn: 这项研究发表在一份知名的科学期刊上。

words.example_en: A comprehension task tested how quickly they understood each word.
words.example_cn: 一项理解任务测试他们理解每个词的速度。

words.example_en: They had to choose the corresponding image for each spoken word.
words.example_cn: 他们要为每个听到的词选出相应的图片。

words.example_en: The trick was that a similar-sounding word was added to confuse them.
words.example_cn: 诀窍在于加入了一个发音相近的词来迷惑他们。

words.example_en: Bilingual speakers were better at ignoring the distracting words.
words.example_cn: 双语者更善于忽略那些干扰的词。

words.example_en: Each list contained one target word and several similar ones.
words.example_cn: 每张词表都含有一个目标词和几个相似的词。

words.example_en: The test compared simple pairs such as 'candy' versus 'candle'.
words.example_cn: 测试比较了像 candy 与 candle 这样的简单词对。

words.example_en: A good listener can filter out sounds that do not matter.
words.example_cn: 好的倾听者能过滤掉无关紧要的声音。

words.example_en: Speaking two languages has considerable benefits for the brain.
words.example_cn: 会说两种语言对大脑有相当大的好处。

words.meaning_cn: 会说两种语言的;双语的
words.example_en: Bilingual people can switch between two languages with ease.
words.example_cn: 双语者能够轻松地在两种语言之间切换。

words.example_en: Learning a language challenges the grey cells in our brain.
words.example_cn: 学习语言会锻炼我们大脑里的灰色细胞。

words.example_en: Language can significantly shape the way we see the world.
words.example_cn: 语言能显著地塑造我们看待世界的方式。

words.example_en: Russian speakers recognise shades of blue faster than English speakers.
words.example_cn: 俄语者比英语者更快地辨认出蓝色的深浅。

words.example_en: Languages differ in how they describe the same accident.
words.example_cn: 各种语言在描述同一场意外时各不相同。

words.example_en: The structure of a language can mirror how its speakers think.
words.example_cn: 一门语言的结构能映照出使用者的思维方式。

words.example_en: Each language seems to create its own kind of reality.
words.example_cn: 每种语言似乎都创造出自己的一种现实。

words.example_en: The words we use may affect the decisions we make.
words.example_cn: 我们使用的词语可能影响我们做出的决定。

words.example_en: Some languages make us less likely to blame a person for an accident.
words.example_cn: 有些语言让我们不太会把意外归咎于某个人。

words.example_en: To have a second language, it is said, is to have a second soul.
words.example_cn: 人们说,拥有第二语言就是拥有第二个灵魂。

words.example_en: It is not really about how people elsewhere think, but about how you think.
words.example_cn: 这其实无关别处的人如何思考,而关乎你如何思考。

words.example_en: The variety of languages reveals how brilliant the human mind is.
words.example_cn: 语言的多样性揭示了人类心智多么卓越。

words.example_en: Language can have early effects on a child's thinking.
words.example_cn: 语言会对儿童的思维产生早期影响。

words.example_en: Small word choices can have a real impact on our judgement.
words.example_cn: 细小的用词选择能对我们的判断产生真实的影响。

words.meaning_cn: 灵活的;可变通的;柔韧的
words.example_en: Our minds are flexible enough to learn many languages.
words.example_cn: 我们的心智足够灵活,能学会许多种语言。

words.example_en: There is a beautiful variety of languages in the world.
words.example_cn: 世界上有着丰富多样的语言。

words.example_en: Even unborn babies can distinguish between two languages.
words.example_cn: 甚至尚未出生的婴儿也能区分两种语言。

words.example_en: Learning a language can give you a more global mindset.
words.example_cn: 学习一门语言能让你拥有更全球化的思维方式。

words.example_en: The famous hypothesis claims that language shapes thought.
words.example_cn: 那个著名的假说认为语言塑造思维。

words.example_en: Many linguists are working hard to save dying languages.
words.example_cn: 许多语言学家正在努力拯救濒临消亡的语言。

words.example_en: Input and output both matter in language acquisition.
words.example_cn: 在语言习得中,输入和输出都很重要。

words.example_en: The language we speak may change how we perceive the world.
words.example_cn: 我们所说的语言可能改变我们感知世界的方式。

words.example_en: Some argue that language can even determine our thoughts.
words.example_cn: 有人主张语言甚至能决定我们的思想。

words.example_en: The students followed a demanding language-learning programme.
words.example_cn: 学生们参加了一个要求很高的语言学习项目。

words.example_en: The effort to switch between languages strengthens the brain.
words.example_cn: 在语言之间切换所付出的努力能强化大脑。

words.example_en: Different languages make us pay attention to different things.
words.example_cn: 不同的语言让我们关注不同的事物。

words.example_en: There are many endangered languages in Australia today.
words.example_cn: 如今澳大利亚有许多濒危语言。

words.example_en: Experts predict that half of all languages may disappear.
words.example_cn: 专家预测,所有语言中或许有一半会消失。

words.example_en: The words people use can have an impact on how they feel.
words.example_cn: 人们使用的词语能对他们的感受产生影响。

words.example_en: A second language opens up a new way of looking at the world.
words.example_cn: 第二语言开启了一种看待世界的新方式。
